propositions: Four rendered non-bridge advanced route parsers (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stdlib argparse.HelpFormatter instead of version-pinned RebarHelpFormatter, creating width inconsistency (78 vs 80) and py3.13 staleness risk in committed help artifacts

py3.13 argparse divergences in short+long metavar rendering and subparser usage wrapping cause help-generation regression that silently stales committed artifacts only on py3.13 CI without detecting the drift

Contract test validates all help-backed (rendered) route parser factories use RebarHelpFormatter subclass; switches four affected factories and verifies byte-identical help regeneration across py3.11/3.12/3.13

Intercept-group advanced parsers (verify, reconcile, config, etc.) are out of scope: gen_cli_help.py never renders them and gen_cli_reference.py already canonicalizes cross-version via design-layer unwrap/collapse logic
